## Glossary
- [术语表](https://siuserxiaowei.github.io/geolyze-replica/zh-cn/glossary/)
- Terms cover GEO, AEO, AI citations, answer engines, structured data, monitoring, and content citability.

## Reports
- [研究简报](https://siuserxiaowei.github.io/geolyze-replica/zh-cn/reports/)
- Reports summarize trends from the local metadata index and link back to original publishers.

## Scope
- Published: metadata/local summaries, canonical source links, topic tags, source labels, freshness risk, and local classification.
- Not published: third-party full text, copied article introductions, copied screenshots, downloaded brand assets, or paywalled material.
- 中文边界：本站只发布公开来源的元数据和本地原创摘要，不发布第三方全文；文章版权归原发布方。
